% The conversion WITHOUT the C-FRAMETITLE workaround: class swapped, [c] mapped to
% vertical-alignment=center (that is C-FRAME-OPT's job and convert_deck.py does it), but the
% braced title left in place. Compiles clean, right page count, Tagged: yes -- and the title
% text is BODY TEXT. Measured: "Objectives" sits at 0.475 of page height, the same line as
% "Body text.", while a real \frametitle puts it at 0.023. The header bar is empty.
%
% The second frame is the leading-<overlayspec> form. It behaves identically; it is here
% because that shape fell through every regex until it was found on a real course, so the
% fixture keeps a case of it.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[vertical-alignment=center]{Objectives}
Body text.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}<1>[vertical-alignment=center]{Overlay spec ahead of the options bracket}
Body text.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
